title: Tangy Nut Gooey Flatbread
description: A sweet and savory flatbread topped with a tangy gooey sauce and crunchy nuts. Perfect for a vegan snack.

ingredients.name: Tangy Gooey Sauce
ingredients.notes: Make by blending 1/4 cup hummus with 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar

ingredients.name: Chopped Nuts
ingredients.notes: Choose your favorite nuts, such as almonds or walnuts

instructions: Place the flatbread on a baking sheet.
Spread the tangy gooey sauce evenly over the flatbread.
Sprinkle chopped nuts over the sauce.
Bake in the preheated oven for 8-10 minutes, or until the nuts are toasted.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 2-3 minutes.
